rationale: A mouse wheel that resolves inside an open overlay is now contained by that overlay: the wheel bubble walk in deliver_mouse_wheel (pointer_dispatch.cpp) stops at the overlay root reported by route_passive_pointer, so neither a native wheel handler nor a DOM wheel listener outside the overlay sees a tick that nothing inside the overlay consumed. The retained-ui-kernel touch is confined to truncating the captured bubble path at the overlay root and scoping the overlay id as the wheel boundary for the JS event builder; with no open overlay the full path is used unchanged. Hit testing, press routing, dismissal, paint, and layout are unchanged. The overlay stack and its passive-pointer routing are Pulp's own popover/dialog model with no counterpart framework behavior to backport, so this is recorded pulp-only.
